SSE ChaCha block generation for 8- and 20-round variants.

# Purpose
This C file implements SSE accelerated ChaCha block generation. The core function, [`fd_chacha_block_sse`](<#fd_chacha_block_sse>), builds the 16-word ChaCha state from the fixed constants, the 256-bit key, and the block index plus nonce, then runs the ChaCha round function with SIMD operations. It uses SSE vector types and shuffle instructions to perform the quarter-round steps and the required word rotations, then adds the original input state back into the working state and stores the final 64-byte block into the output buffer.

The file also defines two public entry points, [`fd_chacha8_block`](<#fd_chacha8_block>) and [`fd_chacha20_block`](<#fd_chacha20_block>). These functions call the shared SSE implementation with different round counts, so the same code can produce either ChaCha8 or ChaCha20 output. The file is therefore a low-level cryptographic implementation file that provides block-level ChaCha primitives for use by other code.
